Samus escapes containment, but has to make her way out of whatever Galactic Federation research/prison station (or maybe it's a base on a planet). It'll have a good baked in reason as to why she has to collect power ups because obviously the Federation stripped her of all her power ups like the essentially had to do in Fusion
